title: EduEdge Orientation and Safe Navigation
short_description: Understand the EduEdge shell, active branch context, product menu, notifications, support, and safe data-handling rules.

steps.title: Confirm your user role
steps.description: Check that the role shown by your training path matches your responsibility.

steps.title: Review the EduEdge shell
steps.description: Locate the product sidebar, active branch context, notifications, profile, and waffle menu.

steps.title: Confirm the active branch or campus
steps.description: Do not enter operational records until the correct campus is active.

steps.title: Learn the support and escalation path
steps.description: Know when to contact your school administrator and when an issue should reach ProcessEdge.

title: Student Quick Start
short_description: Learn how to sign in, confirm your profile, follow school instructions, and protect your account.

steps.title: Sign in safely
steps.description: Use only your assigned account and never share your password or examination session.

steps.title: Confirm your student identity
steps.description: Check your name, school, class, programme, and branch before continuing.

steps.title: Find your assigned work
steps.description: Follow your school’s links for classes, CBT, results, report cards, or learning content.

steps.title: Request help correctly
steps.description: Report missing access, an incorrect profile, or a wrong class to the school administrator.

title: CBT, Pending Sync, Results and Report Cards
short_description: Prepare for offline-resilient CBT, recognise pending answer sync, and review approved results safely.

steps.title: Prepare your device and network
steps.description: Charge the device, use the approved browser, and arrive before the examination starts.

steps.title: Understand answer saving
steps.description: Confirm answers are saved locally and synced; never open duplicate attempts.

steps.title: Handle pending sync correctly
steps.description: Remain with the invigilator until pending answers are confirmed by the server.

steps.title: Review only approved results
steps.description: Use published results and report cards; direct questions through the school’s review process.

title: Teacher Daily Operations
short_description: Use the correct campus context to review schedules, run classes, mark attendance, and hand off issues.

steps.title: Activate the correct campus
steps.description: Confirm the active branch before opening classes, schedules, or attendance.

steps.title: Review today’s schedule
steps.description: Confirm class, room, course, date, time, and assigned teacher.

steps.title: Mark and review attendance
steps.description: Use the correct Student Group and verify every learner before submitting.

steps.title: Hand off exceptions
steps.description: Escalate wrong class membership, duplicate students, or branch conflicts instead of forcing invalid data.

title: Assessments, Results and Report-Card Handoffs
short_description: Prepare assessment work, enter complete results, respect approval boundaries, and add useful report-card comments.

steps.title: Confirm the assessment plan
steps.description: Check class, course, branch, grading scale, and dates before entering scores.

steps.title: Enter complete and accurate results
steps.description: Review every student and resolve missing or out-of-range scores before handoff.

steps.title: Submit for authorised review
steps.description: Do not publish results directly unless your role and workflow explicitly permit it.

steps.title: Add useful report-card comments
steps.description: Use factual, respectful comments and leave progression decisions for authorised approval.

title: School Foundation, Branches and Staff Access
short_description: Set up company and campus context, assign staff correctly, and activate branch governance safely.

steps.title: Review Setup Center readiness
steps.description: Resolve blockers in the correct sequence instead of creating records randomly.

steps.title: Configure each branch or campus
steps.description: Set campus identity, company, cost centre, and operational defaults accurately.

steps.title: Assign staff to permitted campuses
steps.description: Grant only the access needed for each person’s role and responsibilities.

steps.title: Activate branch enforcement safely
steps.description: Verify coverage and defaults before enabling strict branch controls.

title: Programmes, Admissions and Academic Operations
short_description: Configure programme offerings, publish branch-specific admissions, process applicants, and prepare academic operations.

steps.title: Define the programme catalogue
steps.description: Create stable programme records before assigning them to campuses.

steps.title: Create branch-specific programme offerings
steps.description: Select campus, academic year, active status, and admission availability.

steps.title: Publish separate admissions per campus
steps.description: Use a branch-specific title and select only programmes offered by that campus.

steps.title: Process applicants and prepare classes
steps.description: Review applications, create students safely, then configure schedules and attendance operations.

title: School Ownership, Governance and Readiness
short_description: Understand management responsibilities, role separation, branch readiness, approvals, and data-quality accountability.

steps.title: Appoint responsible process owners
steps.description: Assign named owners for setup, admissions, academics, finance, CBT, and student safety.

steps.title: Review role separation
steps.description: Avoid giving every user System Manager access; use purpose-built roles and campus assignments.

steps.title: Review foundation and branch readiness
steps.description: Resolve blockers before operational rollout or branch enforcement.

steps.title: Approve the operating governance cycle
steps.description: Confirm review frequency, escalation routes, and accountable approvers.

title: Platform Access, Reporting and Support Oversight
short_description: Oversee CoreEdge access, subscription health, executive reporting, audit evidence, support, and continuity.

steps.title: Review product access and platform status
steps.description: Know who owns CoreEdge activation, subscription, domain, backups, and support contacts.

steps.title: Review executive and branch reports
steps.description: Use branch and date filters and open source records before making decisions.

steps.title: Verify audit and approval evidence
steps.description: Check publication, progression, access, and support decisions through authorised logs.

steps.title: Test support and continuity arrangements
steps.description: Confirm escalation, backup ownership, recovery expectations, and annual access review.

title: ProcessEdge Tenant Provisioning and Handover
short_description: Provision a dedicated school site, connect CoreEdge, configure identity and initial governance, then hand over securely.

steps.title: Provision the dedicated Frappe site
steps.description: Use one unrelated school customer per site and install only the required product dependencies.

steps.title: Connect and verify CoreEdge
steps.description: Configure tenant key, service credentials, runtime context, access decision, and fail-closed policy.

steps.title: Bootstrap the school foundation
steps.description: Create the initial company, campus, owner, school administrator, and branch governance records.

steps.title: Complete secure handover
steps.description: Train named users, transfer credentials safely, record acceptance, and retain support ownership boundaries.

title: ProcessEdge Support, Diagnostics and Upgrades
short_description: Diagnose product and platform issues, protect accounting and academic truth, upgrade safely, and document every intervention.

steps.title: Capture tenant, branch, user, route, and error context
steps.description: Reproduce with the least privilege needed and avoid broad production experimentation.

steps.title: Separate platform, product, Frappe, and data causes
steps.description: Check CoreEdge access, product assets, permissions, migrations, and data validation independently.

steps.title: Apply the smallest safe correction
steps.description: Use idempotent patches, preserve submitted records, run focused tests, and document migration effects.

steps.title: Verify, communicate, and close
steps.description: Run technical and role-based QA, record files and commands, and confirm the client-visible result.
